independently drawn identical object; never clone or paste; preserve A

geometry_variants_policy: For each variation restore A to recorded baseline by supported UI, then change only named parameter. Log restoration; do not use delete/redraw/clone. If identity retention cannot be attested, mark uncontrolled.

z_unavailable_policy: Record unavailable and stop short of arbitrary-z closure; never fabricate a nonzero z capture.
